title: Table top birch tree
text: Table top birch tree. I purchased this tree with the idea of hanging seasonal things in it year round.  The lights have a timer when using the battery option, although it also comes with a plug in - no timer for the plug in.  In my opinion it is just beautiful.  It comes with a burlap bag and jute string if you want to bag the base for decor... I chose not to use it - not my style.  The trunk of the tree looks just like a beautiful birch tree.  And there are just enough branches and lights on the branches for me.  I have included some photos to help.  One shows how I took it out of the box, the top branches are bent, but easily arranged.  I purchased a slew of seasonal hanging items. - there are some really terrific ones out there, just the right size too, between one and two inches.  It's going to be fun to do.  I hope it lasts a really long time!  Having said that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  And I hope my photos and info were helpful to you!
